items.source: Abstract base class for filesystem-based ahead-of-time (AOT) processing.
items.translation: 用于基于文件系统的提前编译（AOT）处理的抽象基类。
AOT 处理器的通用设置。

items.source: Builder for an AOT contribution that detects the presence of @Reflective on annotated elements and invoke the underlying ReflectiveProcessor implementations.
items.translation: 用于构建 AOT 贡献的BeanFactoryInitializationAotContribution，该贡献能够检测已标注元素上是否存在 @Reflective 注解，并调用底层的 ReflectiveProcessor 实现。

items.source: Specialized ApplicationContextInitializer used to initialize a ConfigurableApplicationContext using artifacts that were generated ahead-of-time.
items.translation: 专用的 ApplicationContextInitializer 用于使用预先生成的工件初始化一个 ConfigurableApplicationContext。

items.source: Fluent builder API for AbstractAotProcessor.Settings.
items.translation: 用于 `AbstractAotProcessor.Settings` 的流式构建器 API。

items.source: Ahead-of-time (AOT) support for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的提前编译（AOT）支持。
应用上下文的 AOT 支持。
